name: ER-1 probe droid
description: The ER-1 was a Naboo-built probe droid designed to operate under extreme temperature and pressure conditions. Repulsorlifts provided the ER-1 with mobility, and the model was also outfitted with high-end sensor, recording, and communications devices. The ER-1 carried twelve deployable biosensors, along with a set of repulsor-powered sensors and recording devices, slaved to the main unit. The peripherals were designed to transmit all data collected back to the droid for analysis.
